about.title: About PT. Alfian Sejahtera Abadi
about.metaDesc: PT. Alfian Sejahtera Abadi is a trusted travel agency specializing in Elderly Service (Khidmat Lansia)
about.story1: PT. Alfian Sejahtera Abadi is a company engaged in the Tourism Travel Agency business, namely providing travel planning services and/or tourism services and administration, including the administration of Hajj and Umrah pilgrimage trips.
about.story2: By prioritizing "ELDERLY SERVICE" (Khidmat Lansia) in every Tour, Umrah, and Hajj service, we are committed to meeting consumer requirements and increasing customer satisfaction using International Standards.
about.story3: PT. Alfian Sejahtera Abadi is a professional Travel company that has personally spent 15 years accompanying and guiding parents and elderly pilgrims for Hajj and Umrah.
about.reason1Desc: 15 years of experience guiding Hajj and Umrah pilgrims, especially parents and the elderly.
about.reason2Desc: Specialized services that prioritize the comfort and needs of elderly pilgrims.
about.reason3Desc: Committed to increasing customer satisfaction using International Standards.
about.reason4Desc: Managed by a professional team experienced in the tourism travel agency industry.
about.reason5Desc: Intensive and patient worship guidance in accordance with Islamic law.
about.vision: To become a leading travel agency that prioritizes service and comfort for pilgrims through the Elderly Service program.

testimoni.title: Pilgrim Testimonials
testimoni.metaDesc: Read experiences of pilgrims who have used Alfian Tour services
testimoni.subtitle: What Our Pilgrims Say?
testimoni.testi1Text: Alhamdulillah, the Umrah journey with Alfian Tour was amazing. Hotel near Masjidil Haram, delicious food, and the ustadz guide was incredibly patient!
testimoni.testi2Text: First time Umrah and chose Alfian Tour. Excellent service! From departure to return, everything was handled perfectly. Highly recommended!
testimoni.testi3Text: I have done Umrah 3 times, and Alfian Tour remains the best. Complete worship guidance, strategic hotels. InsyaAllah, Umrah again with Alfian Tour next year.
testimoni.testi4Text: Very friendly and professional service. As an elderly pilgrim, the assistance from the Alfian Tour team was invaluable. Thank you so much!
testimoni.testi5Text: A very complete family Umrah package. The children also enjoyed the special program for them. Alfian Tour is indeed the right choice for families.
testimoni.testi6Text: Alfian Tour is highly recommended for first-time Umrah. Everything is explained in detail from start to finish. Just go, everything else is taken care of!
testimoni.testi7Text: Affordable price but five-star quality. Delicious food, comfortable hotel, and most importantly the ustadz is always ready to guide worship anytime.
testimoni.testi8Text: Thank you Alfian Tour! An unforgettable Umrah journey. May Allah reward the entire team. Aamiin.

tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.metaDesc: Terms of service for using Alfian Tour
tos.subtitle: Alfian Tour Terms of Service
tos.intro: By using Alfian Tour's services, you agree to the following terms of service:
tos.section1Desc: Registration is done by submitting required documents and payment according to applicable regulations.
tos.section2Desc: Payment can be made via bank transfer or other provided payment methods. Package prices are subject to change.
tos.section3Desc: Trip cancellations are subject to administrative fees in accordance with applicable regulations.
tos.section4Desc: Schedule changes by pilgrims may incur additional costs depending on availability and airline policies.
tos.section5Desc: Alfian Tour is responsible for services listed in the package. Changes beyond our control will be communicated as soon as possible.
tos.section6Desc: Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing. Refunds are calculated based on consumed cost components (airline, hotel, visa, handling, and third-party fees) plus administrative charges. Refund amounts are case-by-case depending on actual reservation status.
tos.section7Desc: In force majeure situations such as natural disasters, outbreaks, government restrictions, airline operational disruptions, or destination access closure, schedules/services may change. Alfian Tour will provide rescheduling options or service adjustments subject to partner terms.
tos.section8Desc: Official complaints can be submitted through the company's official channels (WhatsApp, email, or office). Our team targets an initial response within 1x24 business hours, with periodic status updates until resolution.
tos.section9Desc: Agents, affiliates, marketers, or users are prohibited from registering themselves, duplicate accounts, fake family accounts, self-controlled identities, or invalid data solely to obtain activity bonuses, referrals, rankings, commissions, or promotional benefits. Alfian Tour may void bonuses, hold commissions, lower rankings, disable affiliate access, request additional verification, or suspend accounts if manipulation is indicated.
